data.name: Manoj
data.gender_notes: Manoj is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit manas, 'mind', + ja, 'born' — 'born of the mind'. Its root is Sanskrit manas + ja. An epithet of Kama, the god of love. Manoj is a Sanskrit name meaning “Born of the mind; cupid”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Manoj expresses “Born of the mind; cupid”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit manas, 'mind', + ja, 'born' — 'born of the mind'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manoj total 17, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.
